description: We are Team Odyssey & Orbit, five students from Bangladesh who love space and storytelling. Tafim leads the team and the research, Rana builds the website and its design, Rifat checks every NASA fact and photo, Arman creates our videos and visuals, and Nowrin writes the stories and gives them her voice. Together we turned NASA's forgotten machines into friendly storytellers, so every child can meet them, learn real science and dream big.
